channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Globo cancela debate e cita 'insegurança jurídica' com decisões judiciais; acompanhe as reações
item.description: Rede Globo canceled the debate scheduled for Thursday (01/10) citing legal insecurity from judicial decisions. Lula had already announced he would not attend; Flávio withdrew after a TSE decision; Renan was authorized by the STF. BBC News Brasil is covering the event live.

item.title: Comício de Haddad vira apelo por virada milagrosa em SP e reeleição de Lula
item.description: Haddad's rally in São Paulo transformed into a pro-Lula reelection appeal. The PT campaign used the event to mobilize votes in the final week.

item.title: Globo cancela debate presidencial após decisões judiciais e ausência de candidatos
item.description: TV Globo canceled the presidential debate due to judicial decisions that changed the rules and the absence of candidates Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, who chose not to participate.

item.title: Debate: TSE proíbe púlpito vazio e perguntas a Lula, Flávio desiste e Gilmar obriga Renan
item.description: The TSE banned empty pulpits and direct questions to Lula, requiring all candidates to use pre-programmed interactions. Flávio withdrew from the debate following the judicial decision, while Gilmar was compelled to allow Renan Calder to participate according to the new rules established.

item.title: Leia a íntegra da nota em que a TV Globo anunciou o cancelamento do debate presidencial
item.description: TV Globo canceled the 2026 presidential debate after receiving two notifications: one from Minister Stella Aranha (TSE) at PT's request, invalidating absentee candidate rules, and another from Justice Gilmar Mendes (STF), mandating Renan Santos (Missão)'s inclusion. With Lula and Flávio Bolsonaros absence, the broadcaster suspended the event due to rule changes.

item.title: Flávio ironiza acordo de Lula com Santos a 3 dias da eleição
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro mocked the agreement between the federal government and Santos FC to use a R$79.7 million plot for the club's training center, accusing Lula of trying to influence voters. He urged the Santos president to accept the deal and vote for him. The agreement does not transfer ownership but allows use for 20 years with monthly payments.

item.title: Celina afirma que o BRB "não vai quebrar" e descarta venda do banco
item.description: Celina Leão, governor of the Federal District and re-election candidate, stated that the Bank of Brasília (BRB) will not go bankrupt and ruled out privatizing the bank, emphasizing her efforts to keep it as a regional bank serving 6,000 families. She criticized political opponents for not offering concrete solutions to BRB.

item.title: Lula e Flávio desistem e “Globo” cancela debate presidencial
item.description: TV Globo canceled the presidential debate after judicial rulings changed the rules, such as banning Lula's podium and including Renan Santos, creating legal uncertainty. Flávio Bolsonaro and other candidates withdrew from participating.

item.title: TV Globo cancela debate de presidenciáveis após decisões de TSE e STF que mudaram regras; colunistas analisam
item.description: TV Globo canceled the presidential debate after rule changes by TSE and STF, leaving the first round without a direct confrontation between leaders. Columnists analyze the impact of this decision on the electoral race. With Lula absent, the campaign dynamics will differ from usual.

item.title: Bets, Bolsa Família e Nossa Senhora: o que realmente move votos
item.description: The interview discusses three key electoral themes for 2026: disinformation involving Our Lady of Aparecida and Flávio Bolsonaro, the ban on online betting via provisional decree, and a 15% increase in the Bolsa Família program. Maurício Moura from the Ideia Institute analyzes data showing the impact of these factors on voting intention, highlighting the historical difficulty of reelection in Brazil. The conversation also explores how these themes connect economy, security, and communication to the electoral dynamic.

item.title: TV Globo cancela debate presidencial após decisões do TSE e do STF que mudaram regras do encontro
item.description: TV Globo canceled the presidential debate after court orders from TSE and STF changed the rules, banning mentions of Lula's name and enforcing Renan Santos's participation. The rulings created legal uncertainty for the broadcaster, which emphasized its commitment to democratic debate.

item.title: Globo cancela debate após decisões da Justiça e desistência de Flávio
item.description: TV Globo canceled the presidential debate scheduled for October 1, 2026, after court decisions removed Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro from the lineup, creating legal uncertainty around participation rules. Judicial rulings restricted absent candidates' presence and modified question protocols, prompting the broadcaster to suspend the event. Other candidates, including Romeu Zema, were granted last-minute inclusion.

item.title: Chefe de comunicação do PT diz que Flávio desistiu de debate por não ter chances de lacrar
item.description: PT's communication secretary Éden Valadares claimed Flávio Bolsonaro withdrew from the Globo debate due to judicial rulings forcing direct confrontation with opponents, preventing scripted campaign messages. Decisions by Minister Estela Aranha and Justice Gilmar Mendes were also cited as reasons for the withdrawal. Lula is set to appear on the Flow podcast to discuss economy and security.

item.title: Globo cancela debate entre candidatos a presidente após decisões judiciais
item.description: TV Globo canceled the presidential debate after receiving two court orders minutes before the event. Justice Gilmar Mendes required Renan Santos (Missão) to participate, while Minister Estela Aranha banned the empty podium of Lula, who declined to attend. The network cited legal insecurity and undue interference in press freedom.

item.title: Estela Aranha: quem é a ministra do TSE que deu a decisão que proibiu púlpito de Lula vazio no debate da Globo
item.description: TSE Minister Estela Aranha ruled to prevent TV Globo from highlighting Lula's empty chair in the presidential debate, following a request from the PT campaign. A USP-educated lawyer, she served as Secretary of Digital Rights under Lula and participated in international AI advisory councils.

item.title: Globo cancela debate com candidatos à Presidência da República
item.description: Globo canceled the presidential debate after two court orders: one from TSE, which invalidated rules on absent candidates (requested by Lula's coalition), and another from STF, which forced the inclusion of Renan Santos (Missão), a candidate with only one lawmaker. The rulings created legal uncertainty for the broadcast.

item.title: PM apura suspeita de bomba em mochila jogada nas proximidades do STF
item.description: The Military Police of Brasília investigates a backpack suspected of containing a bomb near the Supreme Federal Court, at the Three Powers Plaza. During the operation, one man was arrested by the agents, who are conducting a detailed inspection of the area and the backpack to confirm the threat.

item.title: Datafolha: 18% dizem que faziam apostas online ou tinham alguém em casa que apostava
item.description: A new Datafolha survey revealed that 18% of Brazilians claim to have placed online bets or had someone at home who used to bet before the ban. The research was published on January 1, 2026, and highlights behavior toward online gambling in the country. This data reflects the popularity of the betting market and virtual casinos before regulation.

item.title: “Estou completamente confuso e feliz”, diz Renan sobre ida ao debate
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate from Missão à Presidência, celebrated Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes' decision allowing his participation in the Globo TV debate. He stated he was 'completely confused and happy' following the Supreme Court ruling.

item.title: Polícia Militar do DF faz operação para apurar suspeita de bomba nos arredores do STF
item.description: The PM-DF carried out an operation to investigate a suspected bomb threat near the STF, three days before the presidential elections. An individual who threw a backpack at a bus stop was detained by the police. The perimeter was isolated and awaits the arrival of the bomb squad for security assessment.

item.title: Meta bloqueia vídeos de dois comentaristas políticos no Brasil
item.description: Meta blocked Instagram videos from two Brazilian political commentators, Joel Pinheiro da Fonseca and Caio Coppolla, citing compliance with electoral standards for AI-generated content. The action restricted access to the videos within the country, while they remain available internationally.

item.title: Na reta final, ministros se afastam de cargos para ajudar campanha de Lula
item.description: Two Lula government ministers, Guilherme Boulos and José Guimarães, temporarily stepped away from their roles to support the president's reelection campaign. Both will resume duties on Monday after the first round of elections. Aloizio Mercadante, president of BNDES, is also campaigning as a political and economic advisor.

item.title: Quem está na frente nas pesquisas para senador em São Paulo? Veja números
item.description: Recent polls from Quaest and Datafolha show a technical tie between Marina Silva, André do Prado, Simone Tebet, and Guilherme Derrite for the Senate in São Paulo. The 2026 elections will renew two of the three Senate seats per state, allowing two distinct votes per voter. Datafolha (10/1) and Quaest (9/29) indicate close leadership among the top four candidates, with a ±2-point margin of error.

item.title: Saiba por que Bolsonaro não poderá votar na eleição de 2026
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro (PL) will have his political rights suspended in 2026 due to a final criminal conviction by the Federal Supreme Court, preventing him from voting, even though the ineligibility ruling by the Electoral Court does not affect the right to vote. The suspension results from his 27-year and 3-month prison sentence for the coup plot, which became final in November 2025.

item.title: Pela 1ª vez em 20 anos, 1º turno terminará sem confronto de líderes de pesquisas em debate
item.description: The first phase of the 2026 presidential campaign ends without a debate between the polls leaders, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Globo deveria chamar Dino no lugar de Lula para o debate e Mendonça na vaga de Flávio
item.description: The text criticizes the performance of the STF, suggesting that Flávio Dino should replace Lula in debates and that André Mendonça should do so in place of Flávio. It points to judicial actions as electoral interference and questions the impartiality of the ministers. The writing advocates calling Dino and Mendonça to debates, criticizing the political behavior of the Supreme Court.

item.title: Debate da Globo: Vale tudo para os ministros do TSE e do STF, menos as regras eleitorais
item.description: STF and TSE justices challenge electoral debate rules with isolated rulings. This undermines legal coherence and sets precedents that weaken the credibility of electoral justice.

item.title: Campanha de Lula celebra desistência de Flávio Bolsonaro no debate da Globo: “subiu o tom e depois fugiu”
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's campaign celebrated Flávio Bolsonaro's withdrawal from the Globo debate, describing the PL candidate's move as fleeing after 'raising the tone'. Petitioners interpret the decision as a sign of avoidance of direct political confrontation.

item.title: Datafolha: 68% apoiam oferta gratuita de canetas emagrecedoras pelo SUS
item.description: A Datafolba poll released on January 1, 2026, shows 68% of Brazilian voters support the SUS providing weight-loss injections to combat obesity, with 26% opposing, 3% indifferent, and 3% not commenting. The proposal divides opinions but highlights growing public health concerns.

item.title: O número de presos provisórios aptos a votar neste domingo, segundo a Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: Data from TRE-SP and TSE reveals that 12,817 provisional prisoners are eligible to vote in the 2026 elections, including 3,881 in São Paulo. Resolution 23.751/2026 establishes rules for installing voting sections in prisons and juvenile detention units.

item.title: Datafolha: 78% dos eleitores são favoráveis ao fim das bets no Brasil
item.description: A Datafolha survey shows 78% of Brazilian voters support banning online sports betting and online casinos. In response, President Lula issued a provisional measure immediately prohibiting online betting platforms, though congressional approval is required for the ban to become permanent. The measure takes effect immediately, with 120 days for Congress to decide.

item.title: Por que Flávio Bolsonaro decidiu não ir ao debate da Globo?
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro decided not to participate in the Globo debate after judicial decisions changed the event's rules, including the prohibition of displaying Lula's empty chair and the inclusion of new guests. His withdrawal occurs amid growing polarization and absences of key candidates, such as Lula, who chose not to debate and will participate in a podcast at the same time.

item.title: Debate na Globo: TSE proíbe púlpito vazio e perguntas a Lula, Flávio desiste e Gilmar obriga Renan
item.description: The TSE banned TV Globo from showing Lula's empty podium during the debate, while the STF, through Justice Gilmar Mendes, ordered the inclusion of Renan Santos. Flávio Bolsonaro withdrew from the debate, calling the decision media censorship.

item.title: Gilmar Mendes manda ‘Globo’ incluir Renan Santos em debate
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes ordered that candidate Renan Santos of the Mission party participate in the TV Globo debate, citing violations of freedom of expression and political pluralism principles. The ruling came after a lawsuit filed by the Solidarity party, challenging the broadcaster's decision to exclude the candidate. The debate, scheduled for tonight, will feature Augusto Cury, Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema, and Wendal Carmo, following President Lula's withdrawal.

item.title: Tabata Amaral distribui santinhos sem Lula, Alckmin, Tebet e Haddad
item.description: Federal representative Tabata Amaral, president of the PSB in São Paulo and candidate for re-election, distributed campaign leaflets that omitted images and names of other candidates such as Lula, Haddad, Alckmin, and Tebet, according to a report from January 10, 2026. This strategy may reflect an effort to maintain neutrality or avoid explicit alliances with figures from other parties. The PSB has sought to position itself as a progressive alternative without relying on traditional coalitions.

item.title: ‘Nepobaby vingativo e esquerdista decrépito’: o que jornais lá fora falam sobre eleição no Brasil
item.description: International media coverage of the Brazilian election is marked by skepticism, describing the race as an 'unpopularity contest' between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The Economist and The Guardian highlight risks to democracy, economy, and the environment, especially with potential external influences like Trump.

item.title: Dólar vai a R$ 5,22 em dia de estresse nos juros globais. Bolsa fica em 'stand by' por eleições
item.description: The dollar rose to R$5.22 and global interest rates surged, pressuring the Brazilian economy ahead of elections. The stock market remains stable around 185,000 points, while investors await the first round to define strategies.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Datafolha mostra como está disputa entre Tarcísio e Haddad em SP
item.description: A November Datafolha poll shows Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) leading the gubernatorial race in São Paulo with 50%, compared to 35% for Fernando Haddad. Voter rejection is higher for Haddad (45%) than for Tarcísio (29%).

item.title: Datafolha: A quatro dias da eleição, Tarcísio lidera com 50%, contra 33% de Haddad
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas leads voting intentions in São Paulo with 50%, against 33% for Fernando Haddad, according to a Datafolda poll released four days ahead of the election. The margin of error is two percentage points, with blank and invalid votes plus undecided reaching 10%.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede ao STF inquérito contra Lindbergh e Rogério Correia por denúncias contra ele
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro filed a criminal complaint against federal deputies Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) and Rogério Correia (PT-MG), accusing them of defamation. The petition was sent to Minister Luiz Fux at the Supreme Federal Court, requesting an investigation into 20 alleged misconducts by the parliamentarians.

item.title: AGU pede investigação de suposto financiamento dos EUA à agenda anti-STF no Brasil
item.description: The Brazilian Attorney General's Office requested an investigation into alleged U.S. funding of groups seeking to delegitimize the Supreme Federal Court, based on a Guardian report. The Trump administration reportedly allocated $1 million from a human rights fund to support far-right initiatives in Brazil. The case is considered especially serious amid the ongoing electoral period and recent foreign pressure on Brazilian institutions.

item.title: Datafolha: 47% avaliam a gestão Tarcísio como positiva e 21% como negativa em SP
item.description: Datafolha survey shows 47% of São Paulo residents rate Tarcísio de Freitas' administration positively, while 21% view it negatively. In the gubernatorial race, Tarcísio leads with 50% of voting intentions, followed by Fernando Haddad at 33%.

item.title: Datafolha em SP: Tarcísio, 50%; Haddad, 33%
item.description: A Datafolha poll released after the Globo debate shows Tarcísio de Freitas leading with 50% of votes and Fernando Haddad at 33% in the São Paulo gubernatorial race. Among valid votes, the gap widens to 56% for Tarcísio versus 37% for Haddad. In a potential runoff, Tarcísio leads 55% to 45% over Haddad.

item.title: Renan Santos convoca ato em frente à Globo após ficar fora de debate
item.description: Candidate Renan Santos (Missão) called on supporters to protest in front of TV Globo after being excluded from the presidential debate hosted by the network. The party sought judicial guarantees for participation at the TSE and STF, but requests were rejected for not meeting the minimum parliamentary representation required for mandatory debates.

item.title: Barrado em debate, Renan fará protesto na vizinhança da TV Globo
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate from Missão to the Presidency, will protest outside TV Globo after being barred from the debate. Minister Carmen Lucia and the TSE president rejected his requests to participate. The debate will feature Flavio Bolsonaro, Ronaldo Caiado, Augusto Cury, and Romeu Zema.

item.title: AGU pede que Polícia Federal descubra quem recebeu dinheiro de Trump para atacar o STF
item.description: The AGU requested the PF and PGR to investigate alleged Trump payments to Brazilian right-wing leaders to undermine the STF and democracy. A Guardian report revealed Trump funded a Countering Lawfare and Censorship program in Brazil, involving figures like President Lula and the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: A estratégia de Caiado para o debate da Globo
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) defined strategy for Globo debate focusing on self-presentation, highlighting experience as Goiás governor. The campaign assesses that attacks on opponents have low audience outside polarization, prioritizing connection with undecided voters.

item.title: Fachin nega pedido para afastar Dino de ações ligadas a Flávio e Lula nas eleições
item.description: The President of the Supreme Federal Court (STF), Edson Fachin, denied Flávio Bolsonaro's request to remove Minister Flávio Dino from cases related to the 2026 elections. Flávio's lawyers alleged Dino's partiality in matters such as parliamentary amendments, film funding, and political investigations. The decision was made in Suspection Appeal 259, without granting a preliminary injunction to suspend proceedings under Dino's rapporteurship.

item.title: Julgamento sobre 'Nossa Senhora' resolve impasse entre TSE e STF, mas tensão segue alta entre ministros das Cortes
item.description: The TSE ruling on the 'Nossa Senhora' case resolved the conflict between the Electoral Court and the STF, but tensions among judges remain high. The decision removed fake posts attributed to Flávio Bolsonaro, aligning closer to Flávio Dino's stance and limiting André Mendonça's original vote. Despite the resolution, ministers continue exchanging sharp words, with no signs of reconciliation before the first round.

item.title: Fachin rejeita pedido de Flávio Bolsonaro para afastar Dino de processos
item.description: STF president Edson Fachin rejected Flávio Bolsonaro's request to remove Minister Flávio Dino from cases involving President Lula. Flávio claimed Dino is biased due to alleged ties with the PT, though no direct interaction occurred between them in the cited instance.
